effect_description_eng:
[Main] Activate 1 of the effects below. If you have a Digimon with [Examon] in its name in play, activate all of the effects below instead.
・Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
・Unsuspend 1 of your Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and unsuspend 1 of your Digimon.
